async function run(items, read) {
 const groups = items.slices(1);
 for (const batch of groups) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(batch.map(read));
 }
 const wide = items.slices(4);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of wide) await Promise.all(batch.map(read));
}
